jobs.title: Full-Time Concierge (Mon-Fri 4pm-12am)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

Join our team as a concierge and become the epitome of hospitality excellence for our residents. As a trusted ambassador of our community, your primary focus will be delivering exceptional customer service and ensuring every resident’s needs are met with care and professionalism. From warmly greeting guests to providing personalized assistance, you’ll be the friendly, reliable presence our residents depend on. If you have a passion for creating memorable experiences and enjoy making people’s lives easier, this role is a perfect fit. Apply now and be a key part of our commitment to outstanding service. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Class “A” customer service – Building a good rapport with tenants and going above and beyond whenever possible
  • Meet and greet all visitors such as tenants, guests and prospects
  • Ensure reception area is tidy and presentable, with all necessary stationery and material (e.g. pens, forms and brochures)
  • Respond to tenant questions and complaints in a timely manner
  • Ensure that only authorized individuals enter the building
  • Manage incoming phone calls and direct them to the appropriate destination
  • Coordinate reservation for amenity space, loading elevators and loading dock
  • Complete daily building walks, looking for maintenance items, reorganizing furniture/décor and cleaning up whenever needed 
  • Work

jobs.title: Full-Time Overnight Lead Cleaner (Thu-Mon, 11PM-6AM)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The ParkX Porter is responsible for maintaining cleanliness in the common areas at assigned sites. Duties include general upkeep such as pressure washing, window cleaning, trash removal, and routine cleaning tasks. Porter also support event setup and cleanup when necessary and respond to cleanliness concerns as they arise. The position requires reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to work professionally and courteously with property staff, tenants, and visitors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensures all common areas, including sidewalks, lobbies, restrooms, and public spaces are kept clean and presentable.
  • Completes daily cleaning and janitorial tasks as assigned by the Senior Operations Manager, Janitorial.
  • Pressure washes areas as assigned by management.
  • Reports to assigned location in the approved ParkX Porter uniform.
  • Reports to assigned location before the start of the work shift.
  • Ensures compliance with all safety regulations and cleaning standards.
  • Exhibits a professional and courteous demeanor with all site visitors.
  • Acknowledges, greets, and interacts professionally with property staff and guests, using appropriate protocols.
  • Assists management teams with special cleaning or maintenance requests as needed.
  • Always maintains a neat and orderly janitorial closet and storage areas, free of debris and hazards.

jobs.title: Full Time Security Officer (Mon-Fri, 7am-3pm)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The Security Officer for ParkX Management ensures that the facility is run smoothly, safely, cleanly, and is a good experience for residents, tenants, and guests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete hourly patrol route of the property using the security system
  • Access control for guests, tenants and vendors
  • Ensure no property is being damaged
  • Conduct of routine foot patrols in and around building.
  • Perform other duties as assigned 
  • Observation and reporting of safety
  • Issue Banning notices to rule violators      
  • Maintain file for Ban Notices and notify management when necessary
  • Maintain the appearance of the two plaza kiosks 
  • Enforce the “no dogs on the plaza” policy
  • Keep updated information (e.g., Kiss N Ride, Contact Phone #’s, Rules of Conduct) and communicate to guests as needed
  • Report any unknown work that is occurring at the property to management
  • If anyone parks illegally on the plaza, notify Park X, Commercial property management, and Residential property management immediately 
  • Communicate to guests that we must keep the fire access areas accessible for fire trucks and ambulances
  • Close loading dock doors as needed
  • Report any concerns to management
  • Reston and Loudoun Station: Assist the Marketing team before, during, and aft

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician ($1500 Sign on Bonus)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

Join our dedicated maintenance team at a luxury apartment community, where exceptional service and high-quality living standards are top priorities. We are seeking a skilled Maintenance Technician with experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, and general carpentry. This role requires a proactive problem-solver who can perform preventative maintenance and respond to work orders efficiently and professionally. A strong commitment to customer service, clear communication, and a polished, resident-first attitude are essential in maintaining our five-star living environment. #weshowup

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Class “A” customer service – building a good rapport with residents and going above and beyond whenever possible
  • Perform repairs, maintenance, and cleaning of property both interior and exterior
  • Protect and assist in improving the value of the client’s assets
  • Perform PM on unit based and building level equipment
  • Perform emergency on-call service in a rotation order 
  • Perform electrical, plumbing, carpentry, masonry and painting
  • Repair and treat structures such as showers, sinks, appliances, doors/cabinets, walls and building exteriors
  • Make ready units for new move-ins
  • Complete grounds work such as grounds pick up, sweeping and light landscaping
  • Perform other duties as assigned

jobs.title: AVP, Infrastructure Management
jobs.description_text:
Department: Information & Technology

Reports To: VP, Director of Infrastructure

Job Summary

The AVP, Infrastructure Management, serves as a senior, hands-on technical authority responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and improving enterprise infrastructure across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. The role provides broad subject matter expertise across infrastructure disciplines and translates strategic objectives into secure, reliable, scalable, and supportable technical outcomes.

This position operates with a high degree of independence, leads complex cross-functional infrastructure initiatives, and serves as a senior escalation resource. Azure expertise is a key requirement, but the role also requires practical depth across networking, systems, identity, virtualization, storage, backup and recovery, collaboration, telephony, automation, disaster recovery, cybersecurity, and infrastructure operations. jobs.location_raw: San Francisco Or Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description_text:
Solutions Architect — Autonomous Systems & Industrial Base

Role Overview

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Solutions Architect to work with autonomous systems manufacturers, Federal Systems Integrators, and commercial technology companies looking to deliver capabilities into the Federal defense market.

This role sits at the intersection of customer mission needs, complex hardware platforms, and modern cloud-native software. The Solutions Architect will facilitate technical and strategic conversations with customers and partners to understand their systems, identify integration opportunities, and define how cloud-native software, data transport technologies, and modern software deployment patterns can be incorporated into drones, satellites, weapons systems, and other mission-critical platforms.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably between executive-level conversations, system architecture discussions, and hands-on technical discovery. They should be able to translate mission and business requirements into practical architectures that account for constrained, disconnected, intermittent, and bandwidth-limited environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate technical discovery and architecture conversations with autonomous drone manufacturers, Federal Systems Integrators, defense technology companies, and mid-sized commercial companies pursuing federal opportunities.

jobs.title: CMM Programmer
jobs.description_text:
CMM PROGRAMMER (2ND SHIFT)

Freeform is deploying software-defined, autonomous metal 3D printing factories around the world, bringing the scalability of software to physical production. Our proprietary technology stack leverages advanced sensing, real-time controls, and data-driven learning to produce digitally-verified, flawless parts at unprecedented speed and cost. Our mission is to make the transformative power of 3D printing available to all industries at scale and unlock the future of innovation.

We are looking for a detail-oriented CMM Inspector/Programmer to join our quality team and take ownership of inspecting complex metal 3D printed parts. In this hands-on role, you’ll operate our Zeiss Contura CMM using existing Calypso programs, perform part inspections, and clearly communicate results to the engineering and production teams. You’ll also assist in maintaining inspection tools, documenting results, and continuously improving quality workflows. Over time, you’ll have opportunities to learn more advanced metrology tools and inspection methods in our growing lab. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about precision inspection, quality assurance, and continuous improvement, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Researcher (Physical AI)
jobs.description_text:
PRINCIPAL MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCHER (PHYSICAL AI)

Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits.

This architecture enables continuous generation of petabyte-scale, high-fidelity data capturing the physics of metal printing - from in-situ process signals and machine state to geometry and material outcomes. Each factory node contributes to a growing learning system that improves modeling accuracy, control performance, yield, and scalability over time.
